title: Halal vs Tayyib: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Kya aapko pata hai konsi khuraak jaiz hone ke saath paak aur faide-mand hoti hai? Halal shari'at ke mutabiq jaiz aur khorak ki ijazat rakhta hai. Jabke Tayyib paak, saaf, aur jism ke liye mufeed aur aala meyaar ka hota hai. Halal qanooni ijazat hai, jabke Tayyib uski paakizgi aur meyaar. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Kya aapko pata hai konsi khuraak jaiz hone ke saath paak aur faide-mand hoti hai?
Kya aapko Halal aur Tayyib mein farq pata hai?
Halal aur Tayyib ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
